func TestBatch_Errors(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf((`CREATE TABLE `+fixtureKeyspace("")+`.%s (id int primary key, val inet)`), table)))

	// Keep the invalid SELECT inside the native BATCH, so the server rejects
	// the batch itself rather than a preceding PREPARE operation.
	inet, err := ScalarType(TypeInet)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	bound, err := BindUnpreparedOwned(Statement[[]Value, Unit]{
		CQL:    fmt.Sprintf(("SELECT * FROM " + fixtureKeyspace("") + ".%s WHERE id=2 AND val=?"), table),
		Params: DynamicParams, Rows: NoRows,
	}, NewColumns(ColumnSpec{Name: "val", Type: inet}), []Value{NullValue(inet)})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer bound.Close()
	item, err := BatchEntry(bound)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = ExecBatch(ctx, session, LoggedBatch, []BatchItem{item}, Options{})
	require.Error(t, err, "expected to get error for invalid query in batch")
	var server RequestError
	require.ErrorAs(t, err, &server)
}

func TestBatch_SetKeyspace(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	if implCluster.SessionData(session).InternalCfg.ProtoVersion < protoVersion5 {
		t.Skip("keyspace for BATCH message is not supported in protocol < 5")
	}
	const keyspace = "gocql_keyspace_override_test"
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, `CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS `+keyspace+` WITH replication = {'class': 'SimpleStrategy', 'replication_factor': '1'}`))
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "+keyspace+".batch_keyspace(id int, value text, PRIMARY KEY (id))"))
	// Explicit prepare keyspace and execution keyspace must agree. Unqualified
	// member CQL still exercises the v5 BATCH keyspace flag.
	prepared, err := Prepare(ctx, session, Statement[[]Value, Unit]{CQL: "INSERT INTO batch_keyspace(id, value) VALUES (?, ?)", Params: DynamicParams, Rows: NoRows}, PrepareOptions{Keyspace: keyspace})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	first, err := BindOwned(prepared, []Value{IntValue(1), codecTestMust(TextValue("val1"))})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer first.Close()
	second, err := BindOwned(prepared, []Value{IntValue(2), codecTestMust(TextValue("val2"))})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer second.Close()
	_, err = ExecBatch(ctx, session, LoggedBatch, []BatchItem{sessionTestItem(t, first), sessionTestItem(t, second)}, Options{Keyspace: keyspace})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	rows, err := v2Query(ctx, session, "SELECT id, value FROM "+keyspace+".batch_keyspace")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rows.Close()
	got := map[int64]string{}
	for rows.Next() {
		row := rows.Row()
		value, err := row.Get("value")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		text, err := value.Text()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		got[sessionTestInt(t, row, "id")] = text.String()
	}
	require.NoError(t, rows.Err())
	require.NoError(t, rows.Close())
	require.Equal(t, map[int64]string{1: "val1", 2: "val2"}, got)
}

func TestBatch_WithNowInSeconds(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	if implCluster.SessionData(session).InternalCfg.ProtoVersion < protoVersion5 {
		t.Skip("Batch now in seconds are only available on protocol >= 5")
	}
	table := testTableName(t)
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf(`CREATE TABLE %s (id int primary key, val text)`, table)))
	bound := sessionTestBind(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (id, val) VALUES (?, ?) USING TTL 20", table), IntValue(1), codecTestMust(TextValue("val")))
	defer bound.Close()
	_, err := ExecBatch(ctx, session, LoggedBatch, []BatchItem{sessionTestItem(t, bound)}, Options{NowInSeconds: Option[int32]{Value: 0, Set: true}})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	prepared, err := Prepare(ctx, session, Statement[int32, int32]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf(`SELECT TTL(val) FROM %s WHERE id = ?`, table), Params: OneParam(Int32), Rows: OneColumn(Int32)}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	read, err := BindOwned(prepared, int32(1))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer read.Close()
	rows, err := Run(ctx, session, read, Options{NowInSeconds: Option[int32]{Value: 10, Set: true}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rows.Close()
	require.True(t, rows.Next())
	require.Equal(t, int32(10), rows.Row())
	require.False(t, rows.Next())
	require.NoError(t, rows.Err())
}

func TestBatch_WithTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	ctx := context.Background()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()

	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf((`CREATE TABLE `+fixtureKeyspace("")+`.%s (id int primary key, val text)`), table)))

		row, err := v2ReadOne(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf((`SELECT writetime(val) AS written FROM `+fixtureKeyspace("")+`.%s WHERE id = ?`), table), IntValue(id))

func TestBatchLimit(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(id int PRIMARY KEY)", table))
	bound := cassandraWriteBound(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(id) VALUES(?)", table), []Value{IntValue(1)}, PrepareOptions{})
	items := make([]BatchItem, 65537)
	for i := range items {
		items[i] = cassandraItem(t, bound)
	}
	before := session.Metrics()
	_, err := ExecBatch(context.Background(), session, LoggedBatch, items, Options{})
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.Contains(t, err.Error(), "65535")
	require.Equal(t, before.Requests, session.Metrics().Requests, "oversized batches must be rejected before submission")
}

func TestMapScanCAS(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2SessionFromConfig(createV2Cluster(), t, true)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(title varchar,revid timeuuid,last_modified timestamp,deleted boolean,PRIMARY KEY(title,revid))", table))
	rev := NewTimeUUID()
	modified := Timestamp(time.Now().UnixMilli())
	bound := cassandraCASBound(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(title,revid,last_modified,deleted) VALUES(?,?,?,?) IF NOT EXISTS", table), []Value{codecTestMust(TextValue("baz")), cassandraValue(TimeUUIDValue(TimeUUID(rev))), TimestampValue(modified), BoolValue(false)}, DynamicRows)
	require.True(t, cassandraReadBound(t, session, bound, Options{}).Applied)
	result := cassandraReadBound(t, session, bound, Options{})
	require.False(t, result.Applied)
	require.True(t, result.Previous.Set)
	row := result.Previous.Value
	require.Equal(t, "baz", cassandraText(t, row, "title"))
	got, e := cassandraField(t, row, "revid").UUID()
	require.NoError(t, e)
	require.Equal(t, rev, got)
	require.False(t, cassandraBool(t, row, "deleted"))
	require.Equal(t, int64(modified), cassandraInt(t, row, "last_modified"))
}

func TestObserve(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (id int PRIMARY KEY)", table))
	observer := &cassandraObserver{}
	check := func(stmt string, wantErr bool) {
		t.Helper()
		events, attempts := observer.snapshot()
		require.Len(t, events, 1)
		require.NotEmpty(t, attempts)
		require.Equal(t, stmt, events[0].Statement)
		require.Equal(t, fixtureKeyspace(""), events[0].Routing.Keyspace)
		require.Equal(t, wantErr, events[0].Err != nil)
	}
	selectCQL := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id FROM %s WHERE id = ?", table)
	read := cassandraDynamicBound(t, session, selectCQL, []Value{IntValue(43)}, PrepareOptions{})
	rows, err := Run(context.Background(), session, read, Options{Observer: observer})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rows.Close()
	require.False(t, rows.Next())
	require.NoError(t, rows.Close())
	check(selectCQL, false)
	observer.reset()
	insertCQL := fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (id) VALUES (?)", table)
	write := cassandraWriteBound(t, session, insertCQL, []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	_, err = Exec(context.Background(), session, write, Options{Observer: observer})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	check(insertCQL, false)
	observer.reset()
	read = cassandraDynamicBound(t, session, selectCQL, []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.Equal(t, int64(42), cassandraInt(t, cassandraReadBound(t, session, read, Options{Observer: observer}), "id"))
	check(selectCQL, false)
	observer.reset()
	other := createV2Session(t, func(c *Config) { c.Observer = observer })
	defer other.Close()
	observer.reset()
	read = cassandraDynamicBound(t, other, selectCQL, []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.Equal(t, int64(42), cassandraInt(t, cassandraReadBound(t, other, read, Options{}), "id"))
	check(selectCQL, false)
	observer.reset()
	bad := cassandraUnprepared(t, "SELECT id FROM unknown_table WHERE id = 42", DynamicRows)
	_, err = Run(context.Background(), session, bad, Options{Observer: observer})
	require.Error(t, err)
	check("SELECT id FROM unknown_table WHERE id = 42", true)
}

func TestSchemaReset(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	if flagCassVersion.Major == 0 || flagCassVersion.Before(2, 1, 3) {
		t.Skipf("skipping TestSchemaReset due to CASSANDRA-7910 in Cassandra <2.1.3 version=%v", flagCassVersion)
	}
	session := createV2Session(t, func(c *Config) { c.Pool.ConnectionsPerHost = 1 })
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s(id text PRIMARY KEY)", table))
	cassandraWrite(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(id) VALUES(?)", table), codecTestMust(TextValue("test")))
	selectCQL := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM %s WHERE id=?", table)
	before := cassandraDynamicBound(t, session, selectCQL, []Value{codecTestMust(TextValue("test"))}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.Equal(t, "test", cassandraText(t, cassandraReadBound(t, session, before, Options{}), "id"))
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s ADD val text", table))
	cassandraWrite(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s(id,val) VALUES(?,?)", table), codecTestMust(TextValue("test")), codecTestMust(TextValue("test-val")))
	row := cassandraReadBound(t, session, before, Options{})
	require.Equal(t, "test", cassandraText(t, row, "id"))
	require.Equal(t, "test-val", cassandraText(t, row, "val"))
}

cassandra_test.go::TestTracing.complete_assertion_source:
func TestTracing(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	cassandraDDL(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (id int PRIMARY KEY)", table))
	write := cassandraWriteBound(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (id) VALUES (?)", table), []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	result, err := Exec(context.Background(), session, write, Options{Trace: true})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEmpty(t, result.TraceIDs)
	checkTrace := func(ids []UUID) {
		t.Helper()
		require.NotEmpty(t, ids)
		for _, id := range ids {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
			trace, err := session.Trace(ctx, id)
			cancel()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, id, trace.ID)
			require.NotEmpty(t, trace.Events)
		}
	}
	checkTrace(result.TraceIDs)
	read := cassandraDynamicBound(t, session, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id FROM %s WHERE id = ?", table), []Value{IntValue(42)}, PrepareOptions{})
	// Options are explicit per execution; the same binding can be traced repeatedly.
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		rows, err := Run(context.Background(), session, read, Options{Trace: true})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		defer rows.Close()
		require.True(t, rows.Next())
		require.Equal(t, int64(42), cassandraInt(t, rows.Row(), "id"))
		require.False(t, rows.Next())
		require.NoError(t, rows.Close())
		checkTrace(rows.Info().TraceIDs)
	}
}

func TestV2StreamingScalarDomains(t *testing.T) {
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeBoolean, Bool, StreamBool, true)
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeTinyInt, Int8, StreamInt8, int8(-128))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeSmallInt, Int16, StreamInt16, int16(-32768))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeInt, Int32, StreamInt32, int32(math.MinInt32))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeBigInt, Int64, StreamInt64, int64(math.MinInt64))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeFloat, Float32, StreamFloat32, float32(-1.25))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeDouble, Float64, StreamFloat64, math.Inf(-1))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeCounter, CounterCodec, StreamCounter, Counter(-1))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeDate, DateCodec, StreamDate, Date(math.MinInt32))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeTime, TimeCodec, StreamTime, TimeOfDay(nanosecondsPerDay-1))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeTimestamp, TimestampCodec, StreamTimestamp, Timestamp(math.MinInt64))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeDuration, DurationCodec, StreamDuration, cqltype.Duration{Months: math.MinInt32, Days: math.MinInt32, Nanoseconds: math.MinInt64})
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeUUID, UUIDCodec, StreamUUID, cqltype.UUID{1, 2, 3, 4, 5})
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeTimeUUID, TimeUUIDCodec, StreamTimeUUID, TimeUUID(cqltype.NewTimeUUID()))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeInet, InetCodec, StreamInet, netip.MustParseAddr("2001:db8::1"))
	streamScalarCase(t, cqltype.TypeInet, InetCodec, StreamInet, netip.MustParseAddr("127.0.0.1"))
	var badBool bool
	if err := StreamDecodeFixture(t, FoundationScalar(t, cqltype.TypeBoolean), StreamBool, StreamCell([]byte{2}), &badBool, 1); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid boolean accepted")
	}
	var badTime TimeOfDay

func TestMurmur3H1(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	// these examples are based on adding a index number to a sample string in
	// a loop. The expected values were generated by the java datastax murmur3
	// implementation. The number of examples here of increasing lengths ensure
	// test coverage of all tail-length branches in the murmur3 algorithm
	seriesExpected := [...]uint64{
		0x0000000000000000, // ""
		0x2ac9debed546a380, // "0"
		0x649e4eaa7fc1708e, // "01"
		0xce68f60d7c353bdb, // "012"
		0x0f95757ce7f38254, // "0123"
		0x0f04e459497f3fc1, // "01234"
		0x88c0a92586be0a27, // "012345"
		0x13eb9fb82606f7a6, // "0123456"
		0x8236039b7387354d, // "01234567"
		0x4c1e87519fe738ba, // "012345678"
		0x3f9652ac3effeb24, // "0123456789"
		0x3f33760ded9006c6, // "01234567890"
		0xaed70a6631854cb1, // "012345678901"
		0x8a299a8f8e0e2da7, // "0123456789012"
		0x624b675c779249a6, // "01234567890123"
		0xa4b203bb1d90b9a3, // "012345678901234"
		0xa3293ad698ecb99a, // "0123456789012345"
		0xbc740023dbd50048, // "01234567890123456"
		0x3fe5ab9837d25cdd, // "012345678901234567"
		0x2d0338c1ca87d132, // "0123456789012345678"
	}
	sample := ""
	for i, expected := range seriesExpected {
		assertMurmur3H1(t, []byte(sample), expected)

		sample = sample + strconv.Itoa(i%10)
	}

	// Here are some test examples from other driver implementations
	assertMurmur3H1(t, []byte("hello"), 0xcbd8a7b341bd9b02)
	assertMurmur3H1(t, []byte("hello, world"), 0x342fac623a5ebc8e)
	assertMurmur3H1(t, []byte("19 Jan 2038 at 3:14:07 AM"), 0xb89e5988b737affc)
	assertMurmur3H1(t, []byte("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."), 0xcd99481f9ee902c9)
}

func TestParsePreparedMetadataAcceptsValidPkeyCount(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	t.Run("exactly at the bound", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Parallel()

		fr := newFramer(nil, protoVersion4)
		fr.Header = &frm.FrameHeader{Version: protoVersion4 | protoDirectionMask}

		// NO_METADATA so parsing stops right after the pkeys, leaving the buffer
		// holding exactly 2*pkeyCount bytes at the guard: pkeyCount == len(buf)/2.
		fr.WriteInt(int32(frm.FlagNoMetaData))
		fr.WriteInt(0) // colCount
		fr.WriteInt(2) // pkeyCount
		fr.WriteShort(0)
		fr.WriteShort(1)

		// NotPanics, because parsePreparedMetadata is called directly here and so
		// the guard's panic would otherwise take down the whole test binary rather
		// than failing this subtest.
		var meta preparedMetadata
		require.NotPanics(t, func() { meta = fr.ParsePreparedMetadata() })

		require.Equal(t, []int{0, 1}, meta.PkeyColumns)
		require.Empty(t, fr.Buf, "whole metadata block should be consumed")
	})

	t.Run("full prepared frame", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Parallel()

		fr := newFramer(nil, protoVersion4)
		fr.Header = &frm.FrameHeader{Version: protoVersion4 | protoDirectionMask, Op: frm.OpResult}

		fr.WriteInt(frm.ResultKindPrepared)
		fr.WriteShortBytes([]byte{0x01, 0x02, 0x03}) // preparedID
		// prepared metadata
		fr.WriteInt(int32(frm.FlagGlobalTableSpec))
		fr.WriteInt(2) // colCount
		fr.WriteInt(2) // pkeyCount
		fr.WriteShort(0)
		fr.WriteShort(1)
		fr.WriteString("test_ks")
		fr.WriteString("test_tbl")
		fr.WriteString("pk_a")
		fr.WriteShort(uint16(TypeInt))
		fr.WriteString("pk_b")
		fr.WriteShort(uint16(TypeVarchar))
		// result metadata
		fr.WriteInt(int32(frm.FlagNoMetaData))
		fr.WriteInt(0)

		frame, err := fr.ParseFrame()
		require.NoError(t, err)

		prepared, ok := frame.(*resultPreparedFrame)
		require.True(t, ok, "got %T", frame)
		require.Equal(t, []int{0, 1}, prepared.ReqMeta.PkeyColumns)
		require.Len(t, prepared.ReqMeta.Columns, 2)
		require.Empty(t, fr.Buf, "whole frame should be consumed")
	})
}

func TestTracingNewAPI(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	session := createV2Session(t)
	defer session.Close()
	table := testTableName(t)
	require.NoError(t, v2CreateTable(ctx, session, fmt.Sprintf((`CREATE TABLE `+fixtureKeyspace("")+`.%s (id int primary key)`), table)))
	write := sessionTestBind(t, session, fmt.Sprintf(`INSERT INTO %s (id) VALUES (?)`, table), IntValue(42))
	defer write.Close()
	inserted, err := Exec(ctx, session, write, Options{Trace: true})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEmpty(t, inserted.TraceIDs)
	prepared, err := Prepare(ctx, session, Statement[int32, int32]{CQL: fmt.Sprintf(`SELECT id FROM %s WHERE id = ?`, table), Params: OneParam(Int32), Rows: OneColumn(Int32)}, PrepareOptions{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	read, err := BindOwned(prepared, int32(42))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer read.Close()
	rows, err := Run(ctx, session, read, Options{Trace: true})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer rows.Close()
	require.True(t, rows.Next())
	require.Equal(t, int32(42), rows.Row())
	require.False(t, rows.Next())
	require.NoError(t, rows.Err())
	selected := rows.Info()
	require.NoError(t, rows.Close())
	require.NotEmpty(t, selected.TraceIDs)
	// Trace polls readiness under the caller context and returns owned typed
	// events; the legacy Tracer's internal table queries are no longer used.
	for _, id := range append(inserted.TraceIDs, selected.TraceIDs...) {
		info, err := session.Trace(ctx, id)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, id, info.ID)
		require.True(t, info.Coordinator.IsValid(), "trace coordinator missing")
		require.False(t, info.Started.IsZero(), "trace start missing")
		require.NotEmpty(t, info.Events, "trace activities missing")
		for _, event := range info.Events {
			require.NotEmpty(t, event.Activity)
			require.True(t, event.Source.IsValid())
		}
	}
}

func TestStep05DDLSucceededStatusSurvivesAgreementCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	s, conns, peers := runtimeTestSession(t, 1)
	conn := conns[0]
	config := runtimeFor(s).InternalConfig
	config.Metadata.AutomaticAgreement = true
	config.Metadata.RefreshAfterAgreement = false
	runtimeFor(s).InternalConfig = config
	implCluster.InternalSessionConfigureV2Peripheral(s, config)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	entered, serverDone := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(serverDone)
		stream := typedTestReadRequest(t, conn, peers[0])
		body := binary.BigEndian.AppendUint32(nil, frm.ResultKindSchemaChanged)
		for _, value := range []string{"CREATED", "KEYSPACE", "step05"} {
			body = binary.BigEndian.AppendUint16(body, uint16(len(value)))
			body = append(body, value...)
		}
		if _, err := peers[0].Write(typedTestResponse(t, 4, stream, body)); err != nil {
			return
		}
		typedTestReadRequest(t, conn, peers[0])
		close(entered)
		<-ctx.Done()
	}()
	bound := codecTestMust(BindUnpreparedOwned(Statement[Unit, Unit]{CQL: "CREATE KEYSPACE step05", Params: NoParams, Rows: NoRows}, NewColumns(), Unit{}))
	defer bound.Close()
	result := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := Exec(ctx, s, bound, *func() *Options {
			opaqueStorageValuexxxxxxxxxxxxx := new(Options)
			implExecution.OptionsData(opaqueStorageValuexxxxxxxxxxxxx).InternalConnection = conn
			return opaqueStorageValuexxxxxxxxxxxxx
		}())
		result <- err
	}()
	<-entered
	cancel()
	err := <-result
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "DDL succeeded") {
		t.Fatal("canceled post-DDL agreement lost acknowledged success", err)
	}
	conn.Close()
	peers[0].Close()
	<-serverDone
}

func TestStep06FeedbackEnqueueDoesNotWaitForPublication(t *testing.T) {
	s := step06Session(t)
	p := implCluster.InternalSessionPeripheral(s)
	info := RoutingInfo{Keyspace: "ks", Table: "table"}
	stamp := implCluster.InternalSessionCaptureTabletFeedback(s, info, s.Metadata())
	h := step06Hint(t, 0, 100, Option[uint64]{}, hTarget(1, 0))
	p.InternalMu.Lock()
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { implCluster.InternalSessionQueueTabletFeedback(s, h, stamp); close(done) }()
	select {
	case <-done:
		p.InternalMu.Unlock()
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		p.InternalMu.Unlock()
		<-done
		t.Fatal("successful feedback enqueue waited for publication mutex")
	}
}

func TestV2ExclusiveHandoffFinishesPartialHeader(t *testing.T) {
	c, server := typedTestConn(t, 4, nil)
	go c.InternalServe(c.InternalCtx)
	packet := step04EventPacket(t, 4, "CLIENT_ROUTES_CHANGE")
	first := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { server.Write(packet[:1]); close(first) }()
	<-first
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	done := make(chan *exclusiveConn)
	failed := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		r, err := c.InternalReserveExclusive(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			failed <- err
			return
		}
		done <- r
	}()
	select {
	case <-done:
		t.Fatal("handoff occurred mid-header")
	case err := <-failed:
		t.Fatal(err)
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
	}
	sent := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { server.Write(packet[1:]); close(sent) }()
	var r *exclusiveConn
	select {
	case r = <-done:
	case err := <-failed:
		t.Fatal(err)
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	<-sent
	r.InternalClose(true)
}

func TestV2ExclusiveHandoffWaitsForWholeV5Segment(t *testing.T) {
	c, server := typedTestConn(t, 5, nil)
	gate := &step04HeaderPause{entered: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
	c.InternalFrameObserver = gate
	go c.InternalServe(c.InternalCtx)
	event := step04EventPacket(t, 5, "CLIENT_ROUTES_CHANGE")
	packet := codecTestMust(segment.EncodeSpans(typedTestChain(t, event, event), true, false))
	sent := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { server.Write(typedTestBytes(t, packet)); close(sent) }()
	<-gate.entered
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	done := make(chan *exclusiveConn)
	failed := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		r, err := c.InternalReserveExclusive(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			failed <- err
			return
		}
		done <- r
	}()
	select {
	case <-done:
		t.Fatal("handoff occurred with unread validated segment frames")
	case err := <-failed:
		t.Fatal(err)
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
	}
	close(gate.release)
	var r *exclusiveConn
	select {
	case r = <-done:
	case err := <-failed:
		t.Fatal(err)
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	<-sent
	r.InternalClose(true)
}

confirmed_claims: Close rejects new admissions; successful Wait drains pagers, queued/active writers/losers and borrowed payload references, separately from output leases.
Publish-before-events, highest-generation bounded overflow marker/closure, disabled registration, isolated dispatch and shutdown joins.
Validated positive signed-int32 configured frame/decompressed bounds reach raw, v5, handshake, streaming and builtin output acquisition; headers/completion stay int64 on386.
Deep immutable schema/topology snapshots, strict validation/scope/complete-peer protection, partial retained data and drop/recreate/route fences.
Exact host/shard sizing and pending/excess capacity, checked source/NAT fallback, endpoint/sharder/closed-state fences and repair-policy delay/stop.
Private publication-time indices and lazy locality/fallback with no full-host first lookup, deterministic LWT, explicit eligibility and strict pins.
Admission closes before stopping all work, final writes and workers join, current/retained outputs survive and repeated closers share completion.

Effective keyspace/host/shard/leader strictness survives selection/acquisition; canonical partitioner and per-execution timestamp/metadata override reach actual wire.
Detached driver-owned verified TLS, inherited per-host hooks/context/logical SNI, per-connection auth cleanup, actual client certificates/tickets/cloud.
Actual native envelopes retain canonical spans; accepted/queued writes join input lifetime, partial writes poison, stable request IDs reserve orphans until response/death.
